method: Point estimate per case/mode/seed preserves actual suffix1024 stop lengths: matched suffix1024 prefill proxy plus original-long prefill proxy scaled by 2048/source_prompt_tokens, plus rate-scaled min(511, observed suffix1024 replay count). Add original-long chosen teacher-forcing wall once per case and same-mode maximum measured load once. For the upper range, assume every changed suffix2048 free run reaches 511 decode replays, then apply 1.7x to cap-safe variable work with load fixed; the lower endpoint remains observed-stop variable work at 0.7x plus load. This covers changed-trajectory early-stop uncertainty without changing the point estimate.

served.range_basis: Lower uses observed-stop work at 0.7x plus fixed load. Upper uses every free trial at 511 decode replays (512 generated-token cap), applies 1.7x to this cap-safe variable work, then adds fixed load. Point estimate remains based on actual previous stop lengths.

full.range_basis: Lower uses observed-stop work at 0.7x plus fixed load. Upper uses every free trial at 511 decode replays (512 generated-token cap), applies 1.7x to this cap-safe variable work, then adds fixed load. Point estimate remains based on actual previous stop lengths.

range_policy: Per-mode upper bound includes full requested generation cap for each seed even where the suffix1024 source stopped early; point estimates preserve those observed stops.
